home.betaFaqReadyQuestion: Is Motif ready for my project?
home.betaFaqReadyAnswer: Motif is in beta. It reads your project and changes nothing until you press Apply, and it checks each change first — but keep a FieldWorks backup, and try it on a copy before your real project.
home.betaFaqOfficialQuestion: Is Motif an official SIL product?
home.betaFaqOfficialAnswer: Not yet. It is a pilot project within SIL Language Technology: free, open source and actively developed, but not yet officially supported.
